name: DAKI (Drop, Add, Keep, Improve)
trigger: Process bloat, administrative drag, redundant ceremonies.
canvasLine: 4 Quadrants: Drop, Add, Keep, Improve · 60 min

steps.text: Set the stage (5m): recite the Prime Directive; dropping a process is not criticising its author.
Gather data (15m): silent notes into Drop, Add, Keep, Improve.
Generate insights (20m): clear Drop first, naming the capacity it returns.
Decide (15m): deprecate one practice and spend its capacity on one addition.
Close (5m): record what was dropped, so it is not quietly reintroduced.

action: The Dropped practice gets a deprecation date and a replacement; its freed capacity funds the chosen Add.
provenance: Source names the canvas and the intent and leaves the phases' wording and minutes to the facilitator.

origin.note: A common agile format; no documented originator.
